Watch Now FAQ What is the SGLang Summit, and when and where is it taking place? The SGLang Summit is the first-ever event bringing together experts, practitioners, and builders for hands-on training and deep-dive sessions on getting the most out of SGLang on NVIDIA. It takes place on November 12–13 at Fort Mason in San Francisco. Who should attend the SGLang Summit? The summit is designed for developers, programmers, IT professionals, AI researchers, and technical decision-makers who want to stay ahead of the latest open source inference breakthroughs. Who are some of the key NVIDIA speakers presenting at the event? Featured speakers include Joey Conway (Senior Director of Product Management, Deep Learning Software), Ujval Kapasi (VP, AI and HPC Frameworks and Libraries), Jiantao Jiao (Director of AI and Distinguished Scientist), and Luis Ceze (VP, AI Systems Software). How does SGLang integrate with NVIDIA Dynamo? SGLang integrates with NVIDIA Dynamo to deliver production-ready serving on advanced hardware like the GB200 NVL72, supporting multi-token prediction scheduling and disaggregated prefill/decode architectures for extreme speedups. What performance benefits does SGLang provide for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) workloads? By leveraging large-scale parallelism, disaggregated prefill/decode, and multi-token prediction scheduling, SGLang delivers lower latency and multi-x speedups for MoE workloads on NVIDIA systems.
